completionDefinition: Generated inventions do not enter the denominator; authored consequences they unlock count.
currentArchitecture: TypeScript and Vite with a deterministic content-driven core.
Svelte 5 owns the semantic DOM shell while the existing controller preserves behavior and side-effect ordering.
Seeded LifePlans, ProfileV2 archives, authored compendium, replay targets, and typed local product events are implemented.
Worker source includes run/session APIs, HMAC+CSRF capabilities, revisioned idempotent attempts, and bounded generated-gameplay selection.
Public Pages builds keep online-required and Worker endpoints off until production readiness is externally established.
nodes.label: The Ascent of Karl
nodes.northStar: Authored-content completion percentage across archived lives.
nodes.primaryPurpose: An interactive story where combining is how the player chooses what Karl tries, discovers, invents, solves, and becomes.
nodes.promise: Shape Karl's journey through what you combine, collect the history and fates you uncover, and hear the narrator turn every success and disaster into his story.
targetArchitecture: Product truth infrastructure precedes and governs player-facing changes.
Replace the UI with Svelte in one coordinated migration now.
Generated gameplay remains typed, deterministic-validated, run-local, and historically non-authoritative.
Active play becomes online-required only after backend production readiness.
Typed product events remain local until telemetry hosting and consent are approved.

nodes.actor: player combining a pair with an eligible authored recipe
nodes.currentBehavior: The engine records the discovery; the story page and archive show its flavor and optional historical note.
nodes.intendedOutcome: the discovery enters this life and authored completion with truthful story context
nodes.label: attempt.canonical-discovery
nodes.playerJob: understand what was discovered and how the world changed

nodes.actor: player making a validated unscripted combination
